notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Orthion.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, and you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.
